# Terminal Port dependency licenses

These license texts are copied unchanged from the exact registry archives in
`native/terminal_port/Cargo.lock`. The manifest records their archive and text
SHA-256 hashes, source URLs and declared SPDX expressions. It covers the full
locked dependency graph, including optional and target-specific crates. This is
source attribution, not a supported-platform build or renderer adoption claim.

Run `python3 scripts/dev/verify_terminal_port_licenses.py` to verify the lock and
checked-in license text hashes without network access. No crate binaries or
runtime download mechanism are included here.
